text: Hand-curated edges of the concept graph (grants, cancels, lifts, requires) for what the data does not state. Names are glossary terms (name or alias). `via` must be a verbatim quote of the text of one of the two terms (checked by the build, whitespace aside). `why` says why the edge was added; REVIEW it. Edges the data already gives (tools/concept_graph.py: derive_edges) must not be repeated here.

edges.via: A Hero spends a Might Point to declare a Heroic Action
edges.why: Every heroic action costs a Might Point; the popup of Heroic Actions then says what it needs.

edges.via: A model carrying a shield may declare they are Shielding
edges.why: Shielding is only open to a model with a shield.

edges.via: A Cavalry model is a rider and its Mount.
edges.why: A Cavalry model is made of a rider and a Mount.
